topic: Subclass 189 Skilled Independent - the PR route after study
voiceover_full: Studying in Australia and dreaming of staying back? Know subclass 189! It is the Skilled Independent visa. No employer sponsor. No state sponsor. Just your skills. Step one: your job must be on the official skilled occupation list. Step two: get a positive skills assessment. Step three: English score and age within limits. Step four: submit an Expression of Interest in SkillSelect. The points test decides your rank. Get invited, then apply. But remember, invitations are never guaranteed, and cut-offs keep changing. Check the official Home Affairs website. Want a clear plan? DM START to V Visa, or visit V Visa dot in.
